name: Craftsman's Writ: Ornate Mithril Shoulders
summary: A faded, transferable writ requests a pair of Ornate Mithril Shoulders. You are asked to deliver them to the marked location with the writ in hand.

sections.title: A Written Request
sections.body: A customer asks you for Ornate Mithril Shoulders through a note written in faded ink. The writ can be passed from one holder to another, and it also carries details about delivery and payment. You need the writ with you to complete the exchange.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one pair of Ornate Mithril Shoulders.

faq.q: Where do I deliver the shoulders?
faq.answer: The writ directs you to the location marked on your map.

faq.q: Do I need to carry the writ?
faq.answer: Yes. You must have the writ with you to complete the transaction.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.
The note includes information about payment.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Ornate Mithril Shoulders
